data.narrative:
Rebel Space is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Carrie and Gabriel Hernandez that has raised $2.8M to date. The valuation assessment triangulates across a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (2 public, 8 private) including Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $2.8M raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage multiplier typical in Defense & Security, yields $7M. Peer-median analysis across the four comparable companies produces a median valuation of $700M, with the peer set ranging from $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage maturity and market positioning within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

Triangulation of both methods produces a valuation range of $6M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $354M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median results reflects the early stage of Rebel Space relative to the broader peer universe. Key uncertainties include product-market validation progress, differentiation within a crowded defense-tech landscape, and whether peer comparables adequately reflect Rebel Space's specific technology and customer traction.
